definitions.physical_error: Weighted RMSE of normalized 52D physical state to this policy's unforced same-command, same-phase reference. Equal time for curves, equal same-foot return number for section samples.
definitions.return_ratio: Sixth/first actual same-foot section deviation, only complete non-failed sequences with initial deviation > 0.05. Both feet are plotted but not independent trained seeds.
definitions.sustained_recovery: Last-one-second p95 of matched-time physical deviation <= max(0.05, 10% of initial [0,1s] peak). Failed/missing-tail trials are unsuccessful. Rate restricted to excited trials (peak > 0.05).
definitions.tube: Weighted decoded one-step-tangent transverse metric from frozen E/D/H. Fixed radius 1. Final membership requires >=95% of final second inside, no failure, no missing samples.
definitions.protocol: Frozen deterministic actors, saved 101D actor interface, nominal physics, default-state resets, no PPO. Six-axis pulses 80/140N and 25/40Nm with 8% jitter, random force/torque norms up to 160N/45Nm. Four commands and four phases. This evaluates empirical recovery, not fitted full-order eigenvalues.
definitions.all_group: Forced only; unforced controls never enter forced bands/rates.
definitions.rollups: Recomputed on pooled individual samples; do not average medians/IQRs.
definitions.curve_cohort: Nonfailed trials; per-time finite sample count n. Return bands require complete nonfailed sequences.

cohorts.pairing: Exact saved command vectors, phase, condition IDs, labels, groups, requested wrenches, time and metric weights checked across policies.
cohorts.push_design: Per command/phase: signed six-axis pulses 80/140 N and 25/40 N m, 12 repeats with +/-8% jitter; 48 random-6D trials with force/torque norms 15%-100% of 160 N/45 N m; 12 controls. Pulse 0.10 s.

limitations: Descriptive sample IQRs, not training-seed confidence intervals.
One historical checkpoint per policy/model; no new training or physical rollouts.
Strict recovery is teacher 83.72% vs tube 74.74%, not universal tube superiority.
Straight vx=0.8: tube strict recovery about 3.8% vs teacher 79.0%; median tail error 0.326 vs 0.0841.
Matched-time error includes phase offset; it does not isolate posture change from timing change.
Both policies reenter radius-1 tube after exiting, but broad tube membership is not precise motion recovery.
Same-foot e6/e1 is a six-return recovery ratio, not a single-step eigenvalue; feet are not independent training seeds.
Some teacher controls have numerical/contact-sampling variability; baseline variation is not all external-force error.
Curves are decimated for display only; transient peaks between display samples may be missed.

serialization.paths: workspace-relative; sources are not web URLs
